title: Lift the learn sticky CTA above the mobile tab bar (#304)
body:
Refs #304 (agent merge will close with evidence after deploy).

**Defect:** `#learn-sticky-cta` was `fixed bottom-0 z-30` under the `z-40` mobile tab bar — invisible and untappable on every /learn article.

**Change** (template + rebuilt app.css only):
- CTA `bottom-0` → `bottom-[75px]` (the measured tab-bar height)
- `#feedback-fab` offset 5rem → 9rem, scoped to <768px, so it clears the lifted CTA
- Visibility toggled by class instead of inline `display:flex`, which was also showing the bar on desktop (inline style beat `md:hidden`)
- Dropped the retired-purple box-shadow; fixed stale '50%' comment

Engineer-measured at 375x667 (headless Chromium): CTA bottom == tab-bar top, elementFromPoint at CTA centre inside the CTA, FAB 8px clear. Draft until independent QA runs.
